title: Corpus documents and frozen partitions
description: A quick reference for the data-boundary terms used before tokenizer or model fitting begins.

terms.definition: The complete collection of source documents from which tokenizer and model data are prepared.
The indivisible source unit assigned to a partition before token units or training windows are created.
The documents permitted to contribute tokenizer statistics and learned model parameters.
Held-out documents used to compare choices or select a checkpoint, but not to fit parameters.
Sealed documents used for final reported evidence after fitting and model selection are complete.
A partitioning in which every corpus document appears exactly once and no roles overlap.
Data kept outside model fitting so it can provide evidence about unseen text.
Training information crossing into a held-out partition and making its evaluation less independent.
A label joining documents derived from the same source so related versions stay in one partition.
